topic: Picking a Real Christmas Tree at the Holiday Lot

script.title: AT THE TREE LOT
script.scene_zh: 節慶樹園 · 挑聖誕樹
script.story_hook: One perfect tree, one hatchback, and some rope.
script.intro_zh: 一棵完美的樹、一輛掀背車，還有幾條繩子。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to our holiday tree lot. Listen for picking a fresh tree.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的節慶樹園。留意挑樹的說法。
script.outro: A fir rides home, strapped and jolly. Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 冷杉綁好回家過節。再聽一遍，跟著開口。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們放慢速度逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a man in his late twenties with short wavy dark brown hair, no facial hair, an olive green puffer jacket over a grey hoodie, fingerless gloves, and an athletic build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long straight pink-dyed hair under a white knit beanie, freckles, a red plaid flannel shirt with a tree lot name tag, and a tall lanky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are all these trees fresh this week?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɔɹ ɔl ðiz triːz frɛʃ ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這些樹都是本週新鮮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most arrived Tuesday, the firs came today.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst əˈɹaɪvd ˈtuzdeɪ ðə fɜɹz keɪm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大部分是星期二到的，冷杉今天才進貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we want a fir, not a pine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt wi wɑnt ə fɜɹ nɑt ə paɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們想要冷杉，不要松樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great call, firs hold their needles longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt kɔl fɜɹz hoʊd ðɛɹ ˈnidəlz ˈlɔŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這個選擇很好，冷杉比較留得住針葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, how tall is this one right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm haʊ tɔl ɪz ðɪs wʌn ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這一棵大概多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven feet, maybe a hair over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən fit ˈmeɪbi ə hɛɹ ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 七呎，可能還多一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our ceiling's eight feet, that might rub.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹ ˈsɪlɪŋz eɪt fit ðæt maɪt ɹʌb/
dialogue.zh: 我們家天花板八呎，樹頂可能會擦到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then grab six and a half, room for topper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡɹæb sɪks ænd ə hæf ɹum fɚ ˈtɑpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那就選六呎半，給樹頂的星星留空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point, the star adds a whole foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt ðə stɑɹ ædz ə hoʊl fʊt/
dialogue.zh: 說得是，那顆星至少會多佔一呎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See this row by the fence, all shorter?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs ɹoʊ baɪ ðə fɛns ɔl ˈʃɔɹtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 看到圍欄邊那一排了嗎？全都比較矮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and this one is super straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈsuːpɚ stɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，這一棵特別筆直。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straight is rare, most lean toward the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɹeɪt ɪz ɹɛɹ moʊst lin təˈwɔɹd ðə sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 筆直的樹很少見，多半都朝太陽傾斜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I shake it? My kid shakes everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ʃeɪk ɪt maɪ kɪd ʃeɪks ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以搖一下嗎？我家小孩什麼都要搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, hold the trunk, shake once, count drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ hoʊld ðə trʌŋk ʃeɪk wʌns kaʊnt drɑps/
dialogue.zh: 可以，扶住樹幹，搖一次，數掉了多少針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only a few needles fell, that's fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə fju ˈnidəlz fɛl ðæts frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 就掉了幾根針，這棵很新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dropping tree tells you everything, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdrɑpɪŋ tri ˈtɛlz ju ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，會掉針的樹已經說明一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell is the test nobody tells you about.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ɪz ðə tɛst ˈnoʊbədi ˈtɛlz ju əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 聞味道這招，沒人會事先提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This fir smells like oranges, serious test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɜɹ smɛlz laɪk ˈɔɹɪndʒəz ˈsɪɹiəs tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 這棵冷杉聞起來像柳丁，不信你試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way, it does, a little citrusy.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ ɪt dʌz ə ˈlɪɾə ˈsɪɾəsi/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧，真的耶，有點柑橘香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sold already? We barely started tree shopping.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑld ɔlˈɹɛdi wi ˈbɛɹli ˈstɑɹtɪd tri ˈʃɑpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 就買定離手了？我們才剛開始挑樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tree, zero arguments, that's a record.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tri ˈzɪɹoʊ ˈɑɹɡjumənts ðæts ə ˈɹɛkəɹd/
dialogue.zh: 一棵樹、零爭執，已經是我們的紀錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the trunk, want a fresh saw cut?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə trʌŋk wɑnt ə frɛʃ sɔ kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 接著是樹幹，要重新鋸一個新鮮的切口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that actually help it drink water?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt ˈæktʃuəli hɛlp ɪt drɪŋk ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那樣真的比較能吸水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, a clean cut drinks like crazy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ə klin kʌt drɪŋks laɪk ˈkɹeɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，平整的切口吸水吸得兇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes, please cut it, where's the saw?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs pliz kʌt ɪt wɛɹz ðə sɔ/
dialogue.zh: 那就麻煩鋸一下，鋸子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Station by the shed, two bucks per cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪʃən baɪ ðə ʃɛd tu bʌkz pɜɹ kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 棚屋旁有切割台，鋸一次兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap, do you trim the stand notch too?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip du ju tɹɪm ðə stænd nɑtʃ tu/
dialogue.zh: 好便宜，支架卡榫的洞也會幫忙修嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We match every trunk to our stand bins.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mætʃ ˈɛvɹi trʌŋk tə ɑɹ stænd bɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 我們會把每根樹幹都配上店裡的支架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking of stands, I forgot the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɪkɪŋ ʌv stændz aɪ fɚˈɡɑt ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 說到支架，我整個忘記還沒買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic stand aisle, right behind the shed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplæstɪk stænd aɪl ɹaɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 塑膠支架區就在棚屋後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Metal or plastic for a big fir, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɾəl ɔɹ ˈplæstɪk fɚ ə bɪɡ fɜɹ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 大棵的冷杉，該選金屬的還是塑膠的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Metal grips harder, plastic spins when kids shove.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɾəl ɡɹɪps ˈhɑɹdɚ ˈplæstɪk spɪnz wɛn kɪdz ʃʌv/
dialogue.zh: 金屬夾得緊，小孩一推，塑膠的就會轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine shove like tiny sumo wrestlers, daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ʃʌv laɪk ˈtaɪni ˈsumoʊ ˈɹɛslɚz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 我家那小傢伙像小相撲選手，每天推來推去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Metal it is, and take the wide base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɾəl ɪt ɪz ænd teɪk ðə waɪd beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那就選金屬的，底座挑寬一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much water does a big fir drink?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈwɔɾɚ dʌz ə bɪɡ fɜɹ drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 大的冷杉一天要喝多少水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First week, up to a gallon a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst wik ʌp tə ə ˈɡælən ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 第一週一天可能喝掉一加侖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains my dad's bucket runs every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz maɪ dædz ˈbʌkɪt ɹʌnz ˈɛvɹi ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 難怪我爸爸每天早上都提桶來加水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the reservoir, refill keeps needles on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə ˈɹɛzɚˌvɔɹ ɹiˈfɪl kips ˈnidəlz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 要留意底座的水箱，水補夠針葉才不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One worry: will it fit my hatchback?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈwɜɹi wɪl ɪt fɪt maɪ ˈhætʃbæk/
dialogue.zh: 有個煩惱：我的掀背車裝得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trees fit, we strap them on roofs, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹiːz fɪt wi stɹæp ðɛm ɑn ɹufts noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 樹不難放，我們幫您綁上車頂，不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, really? Last year we tied it with scarves.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈɹɪli læst jɪɹ wi taɪd ɪt wɪð skɑɹvz/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？去年我們是用圍巾把它綁上去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holiday scarves, classic move, love that story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑlədeɪ skɑɹvz ˈklæsɪk muːv lʌv ðæt ˈstɔɹi/
dialogue.zh: 用節慶圍巾綁樹，經典又可愛，我喜歡這個故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It survived nine miles home, tree still perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɚˈvaɪvd naɪn maɪlz hoʊm tri stɪl ˈpɜɹfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 九哩路開回家，樹還是很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This year: ropes, pads, and one strong helper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs jɪɹ roʊps pædz ænd wʌn stɹɔŋ ˈhɛlpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 今年有繩子、軟墊，還有力氣大的幫手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll strap it? That changes everything, thank goodness.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul stɹæp ɪt ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs/
dialogue.zh: 你們會幫忙綁？那就完全沒問題了，感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We net it too, keeps branches tight for the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nɛt ɪt tu kips ˈbɹæntʃɪz taɪt fɚ ðə dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 也會幫您套網，讓枝條一路乖乖收攏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the damage for the tree and stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ fɚ ðə tɹi ænd stænd/
dialogue.zh: 樹加支架，一共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-eight, plus stand, say ninety all in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti eɪt plʌz stænd seɪ ˈnaɪnti ɔl ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 樹六十八，支架另算，全部大概九十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, Christmas trees beat hotel prices, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ˈkɹɪsməs triːz biːt hoʊˈtɛləz ˈpɹaɪsəz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 很合理，聖誕樹比旅館便宜太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, and this one won't judge your décor.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ænd ðɪs wʌn woʊnt dʒʌdʒ jɔɹ deɪˈkɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，而且這棵樹不會批評你的裝潢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, my tree skirt hides many secrets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛɹfəl maɪ tri skɜɹt haɪdz ˈmɛni ˈsikɹəts/
dialogue.zh: 小心哦，我的樹裙底下藏著很多秘密。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone's skirt does heavy lifting, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiwʌnz skɜɹt dʌz ˈhɛvi ˈlɪftɪŋ doʊnt ˈwɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 大家的樹裙都在撐場面，不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emailed receipt, please? Paper melts in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪld rɪˈsit pliz ˈpeɪpɚ mɛlts ɪn maɪ kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 收據可以傳電子郵件嗎？紙本會在我車裡消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent already, check spam, our email acts shy.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt ɔlˈɹɛdi tʃɛk spæm ɑɹ ˈimeɪl ækts ʃaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 已經發了，檢查垃圾郵件，我們的信箱有點害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, and one branch bent, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ænd wʌn bɹæntʃ bɛnt ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，另外有根枝條歪了，應該沒關係吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normal, stand it upright overnight, it springs back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɹməl stænd ɪt ˈʌpɹaɪt ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt ɪt sprɪŋz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 很常見，立著放一晚，枝條自己會彈回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a Christmas miracle maker, seriously!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈkɹɪsməs ˈmɪɹəkəl ˈmeɪkɚ ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你根本就是聖誕奇蹟製造機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just doing our job under the twinkling lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst duɪŋ ɑɹ dʒɑb ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈtwɪŋkɪŋ laɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們只是在閃閃的燈下認真工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Merry Christmas, I'll see you next December!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɹi ˈkɹɪsməs aɪl si ju nɛkst dɪˈsɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聖誕快樂，明年十二月再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Merry Christmas, drive slow, giant tree mode!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɹi ˈkɹɪsməs dɹaɪv sloʊ ˈdʒaɪənt tri moʊd/
dialogue.zh: 聖誕快樂，慢點開，巨樹模式上路！

script.youtube_title: 【聖誕樹園🎄】「一棵樹零爭執」教你挑冷杉、驗掉針、綁上車頂🪚🚗🎧｜聽完就會挑樹｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Real Christmas Tree Lot Trip
script.youtube_title_en: One Tree, Zero Arguments — Picking a Real Christmas Tree at the Holiday Lot
script.youtube_description:
「一棵樹、零爭執」——在週末的節慶樹園，怎麼挑一棵筆直、新鮮、還塞得進自己車的聖誕樹？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在掛滿燈串的戶外樹園。

你會聽到：問進貨日、選冷杉或松樹、用搖樹法檢查掉針；鋸樹幹切口、挑金屬支架、算一天喝多少水；還有請人員幫忙套網、綁上車頂、收據傳郵件的完整對話。

全篇使用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人假日的真實語感：um、sure、really、no way、honestly。聽完你就會用：How tall is this one、Do you trim the stand notch、Will it fit my hatchback、What's the damage。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著念，讓舌頭先跟上，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"One tree, zero arguments" — how do you pick a straight, fresh Christmas tree that actually fits your hatchback? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a twinkling holiday tree lot.

You will hear: asking when trees arrived, choosing fir over pine, the shake test for needle drop; getting a fresh saw cut, matching a stand, and planning watering; plus netting, roof-strap help, and an emailed receipt.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real American holiday rhythm: um, sure, really, no way, honestly. By the end you'll own lines like How tall is this one, Do you trim the stand notch, Will it fit my hatchback, and What's the damage.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new real-life scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
聖誕節快到了，樹園裡幾十棵樹，你分得出哪棵新鮮、哪棵筆直嗎？一棵六呎半的冷杉，怎麼塞進一台小車，還完好開回家？

這一集帶大家走進掛滿燈串的節慶樹園，從問進貨日、搖樹驗針，到鋸切口、挑支架、套網綁車頂，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎄 檢查新鮮度：Can I shake it? 搖樹數掉針。
🪚 處理樹幹：Now the trunk, want a fresh saw cut?
🚗 裝車煩惱：One worry: will it fit my hatchback?
💳 結尾問價：What's the damage for the tree and stand?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、sure、really、honestly 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟挑樹之旅走一遍，明年走進樹園，話就會自己開口。

祝你今年也找到那棵零爭執的完美樹。
